lines: # Rule "QA RT27 3230 rule" (On Create, QA PA Dept 1, active), condition: Subject starts with "QA RT27 3230", action: set QA NDC Agency code
PATCH /workflow/rules/{id}  { actions: [...] }   (no criteria)  -> 200   criteria kept: Subject starts with "QA RT27 3230", action changed to A2
ticket "Other subject RT27 3230 nomatch" -> rule not fired, field empty
ticket "QA RT27 3230 match"               -> rule fired once, field = A2   (control)
PATCH /workflow/rules/{id}  { criteria: null }                  -> 200   criteria cleared (explicit null still clears)
change only the action value and Save -> sends the whole rule incl. criteria -> condition kept, action = "A3 editor"
open the condition, Remove condition, Save -> sends criteria: null -> rule reopens with "No conditions - actions run on every event of this trigger"
# Ticket expected: conditions kept when left out; cleared only by explicit criteria: null -> met

title: Workflow Rules | A rule update that leaves out the conditions keeps them; explicit null clears them
Editor: removing the last condition and saving still saves "no conditions"
notes: After Remove condition + Save the editor sent criteria: null; reopened rule shows "No conditions — actions run on every event of this trigger" (so the editor still works with the new API rule).
Side note (not part of this ticket): the diagram still reads "CONDITION 1" when there are no conditions.
